body: Renames the Milk Bottle from the mod Farmer's Delight to Nut Milk Bottle :D I did this on purpose to avoid Duplicating Items from Mods and for the my Modpack.![Recipe of Milk Bottle from Neapolitan and Recipe of Nut Milk Bottle from Farmers Delight (With Delightful Recipe)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90598f3e8e23e5a746bda5d4b1136268c1381a79.png) You can free use this Resource Pack in your Modpacks, if you use mods like Farmer's Delight, Neapolitan, Abnormals Delight and Delightful.
